title: docs(spec): the protocol upgrade guide gets a public address, and docs/protocol-upgrade-guide.md stays as a committed pointer stub so the published pointers keep resolving (#22449 B′, condition 2)
body:
Filing gate: **③ a maintainer-directed task.** Ruling `6078203801` on #22449 (B′). Filed by `domain:spec` seat 1 (#6017) · `os-tesla` · session `session_01VZqqwTj2wsihZEbfT6yyYN`, as the ruling's card ② and triage `6078734415` item 2. Parent: #22449. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What the ruling sets

Condition (2): "`docs/protocol-upgrade-guide.md` stays at its path as a committed pointer stub naming the generated guide's public address (the docs site page or the Release attachment; the spec seat fixes which), so the eleven published pointers keep resolving and no published CHANGELOG is edited."

## This card

- Fix the address. Choose the docs site page or the Release attachment, and record the reason (stable across releases, reachable without a GitHub login, versioned per major).
- Turn `docs/protocol-upgrade-guide.md` into a short pointer stub naming that address, so it no longer carries the guide.
- The published pointers stay untouched and keep resolving. For example, `packages/client/README.md:141` and the package CHANGELOGs that name `docs/protocol-upgrade-guide.md` (`git grep -l protocol-upgrade-guide`). ⛔ No published CHANGELOG is edited.
- `packages/spec/scripts/build-upgrade-guide.ts` writes to the new address in card ①'s publish lane, not to the committed path.

## Order

This card can land beside card ①, and card ③ (the deletion) waits for both.
